    variant decisions:**\n   - Load enriched catalog (existing variants + vanilla blocks)\n   - Analyze visual characteristics\n   - Score similarity (70% threshold)\n   - Decide: reuse existing / use vanilla / create new\n\n3.          

    **Create/update variant files** as needed\n\n### Expected Artifacts:\n\nProvide the following artifacts to advance_workflow:\n- `variantMapping`: Object mapping generic block names to variant names\n- `variantsCreated`: List of      

    new variants created\n- `variantsReused`: List of existing variants reused\n- `enhancedAuthoring`: Authoring analysis with variant block names\n",                                                                                       

      "expectedArtifacts": [

      "instructions": "---\nname: block-variant-manager\ndescription: Manages block variant lifecycle for multi-page migrations including enriched catalog loading, similarity matching, metadata.json management, and variant creation.     

     Scans existing variants, performs intelligent reuse detection with 70% similarity threshold, updates usage metadata, and creates new variants with full metadata tracking. Used by enhanced migration workflows to maintain             

    consistent block styling across pages.\n---\n\n# Block Variant Manager\n\n**Purpose:** Enhance generic block names with intelligent variant tracking for multi-page site migrations.\n\n## When to Use\n\nThis skill is invoked by       

    orchestrator skills (like excat-page-migration) to manage block variants. It is not typically invoked directly by users.\n\n## Input\n\n- **blockNames**: Array of generic block names from authoring analysis (e.g., [\"hero\",         

    \"cards\", \"columns\"])\n- **screenshotPath**: Path to original page screenshot for visual analysis\n- **sourcePageUrl**: Original page URL for tracking\n- **currentPagePath**: Document path for usage tracking (e.g.,                

    \"/content/products\")\n\n## Output\n\n**variantMapping**: Object mapping generic block names to variant names\n\nExample:\n```javascript\n{\n  \"hero\": \"hero-minimal\",     // Created new variant\n  \"cards\":                     

    \"cards-product\",   // Reused existing variant\n  \"columns\": \"columns-simple\" // Created new variant (never use vanilla directly)\n}\n```\n\n## Workflow\n\n### Phase 0: Load Project Settings \n\nLoad the project file            

    .ec-project.json to get the libraryUrl url and EDS blocks url.\n\n### Phase 1: Load Enriched Block Catalog\n\n**Purpose**: Load comprehensive block catalog including both vanilla AEM Edge Delivery blocks and existing custom          

    variants from previous migrations.\n\n**Actions**:\n\n1. **Load vanilla blocks from remote library:**\n   - **Tool**: `get_all_blocks_catalog`\n   - **Parameters**: `{ includeDetails: true }`\n   - **Result**: Lightweight            

    catalog (~2KB) with vanilla block names, descriptions, and when-to-use guidance\n\n2. **Scan local workspace for existing custom blocks:**\n   ```javascript\n   // Scan blocks/ directory for custom variants (directories with         

    hyphens)\n   const allBlockDirs = fs.readdirSync('blocks/').filter(d =>\n     fs.statSync(`blocks/${d}`).isDirectory()\n   );\n   const customBlockDirs = allBlockDirs.filter(d => d.includes('-'));\n\n   const customBlocks =          

    [];\n   for (const dir of customBlockDirs) {\n     const metadataPath = `blocks/${dir}/metadata.json`;\n\n     if (fs.existsSync(metadataPath)) {\n       // Read full metadata for smart matching\n       const metadata =              

    JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(metadataPath, 'utf-8'));\n\n       customBlocks.push({\n         name: metadata.variantName,\n         baseBlock: metadata.baseBlock,\n         description: `Custom variant:                                 

    ${metadata.visualCharacteristics.purpose}. Suitable for: ${metadata.reuseGuidance.suitableFor.join(', ')}`,\n         path: `/blocks/${metadata.variantName}`,\n         source: 'custom',\n         priority: 1,\n                      

    metadata: metadata  // 🔑 Embed full metadata for similarity scoring\n       });\n     } else {\n       // Fallback for custom blocks without metadata\n       const baseBlock = dir.split('-')[0];\n       customBlocks.push({\n        

          name: dir,\n         baseBlock: baseBlock,\n         description: `Custom ${baseBlock} variant`,\n         path: `/blocks/${dir}`,\n         source: 'custom',\n         priority: 1,\n         metadata: null\n       });\n       

       }\n   }\n   ```\n\n3. **Merge into enriched catalog:**\n   ```javascript\n   const enrichedCatalog = {\n     blocks: [\n       // Custom blocks first (priority: 1)\n       ...customBlocks,\n       // Vanilla blocks second         

    (priority: 2)\n       ...vanillaCatalog.blocks.map(b => ({\n         ...b,\n         source: 'vanilla',\n         priority: 2,\n         metadata: null\n       }))\n     ],\n     customBlockCount: customBlocks.length,\n              

    vanillaBlockCount: vanillaCatalog.blocks.length,\n     totalBlocks: customBlocks.length + vanillaCatalog.blocks.length\n   };\n   ```\n\n**Output**:\n- Enriched catalog with custom blocks (with metadata) appearing first\n-           

    Vanilla blocks as fallback templates\n- Ready for smart matching in Phase 2\n\n**Note**: If no custom blocks exist (first migration), catalog contains only vanilla blocks. The workflow automatically adapts.\n\n---\n\n### Phase       

    2: Smart Matching with Similarity Scoring\n\n**Purpose**: Determine if existing variants can be reused for current sections.\n\n**CRITICAL: Always use custom variants, never vanilla blocks directly**\n- ✅ Existing variant           

    matches → REUSE\n- ✅ No match or first occurrence → CREATE new variant\n- ❌ NEVER use vanilla block names directly in HTML\n\nUsing the enriched catalog from Phase 1, analyze each content section and match to appropriate           

    blocks with smart reuse detection:\n\n**Two-Phase Matching Process:**\n\n#### Phase 2.1: Check Custom Blocks First (Smart Matching)\n\nFor each content section:\n\n1. **Identify base block type needed** (hero, cards, columns,        

    etc.)\n2. **Search enriched catalog for matches:**\n   ```javascript\n   const candidates = enrichedCatalog.blocks.filter(b =>\n     b.baseBlock === targetBlock || b.name === targetBlock\n   );\n   ```\n\n3. **Separate custom        

    variants from vanilla blocks:**\n   ```javascript\n   const customCandidates = candidates.filter(b => b.source === 'custom' && b.metadata);\n   const vanillaCandidates = candidates.filter(b => b.source === 'vanilla');\n              

    ```\n\n4. **For custom blocks with metadata, calculate similarity:**\n   ```javascript\n   if (customCandidates.length > 0) {\n     // Analyze current page's visual context for this section\n     const currentContext = {\n           

     colorScheme: 'light',  // From screenshot analysis\n       density: 'minimal',\n       purpose: 'hero',\n       imagePattern: 'noimg',\n       structure: 'heading + 2 CTAs'\n     };\n\n     // Score each custom variant\n            

    const scored = customCandidates.map(block => ({\n       block,\n       score: calculateSimilarity(currentContext, block.metadata.visualCharacteristics)\n     }));\n\n     // Sort by score (highest first)\n     scored.sort((a, b)     

     => b.score - a.score);\n     const bestMatch = scored[0];\n\n     // Reuse if similarity >= 70%\n     if (bestMatch.score >= 0.7) {\n       console.log(`♻️  Reusing custom variant: ${bestMatch.block.name} (${bestMatch.score *        

    100}% match)`);\n       // Use this variant (skip to next section)\n       return bestMatch.block.name;\n     }\n   }\n   ```\n\n#### Phase 2.2: Create New Variant (Always Use Custom Blocks)\n\nIf no custom block matches well        

    (similarity < 70%):\n- ALWAYS mark for new variant creation\n- Select vanilla block as TEMPLATE SOURCE only\n- New variant created in Phase 3\n- NEVER use vanilla block name directly\n\n**Quick Decision Rule: Cards vs                

    Columns**\n- **Cards** = Distinct, repeatable items (products, features, testimonials, team members)\n  - Individual, self-contained items with similar structure\n- **Columns** = General side-by-side text layout, informational       

    content, comparisons\n  - Flexible layout for any side-by-side content\n\n**Common Patterns → Block Matches:**\n```\nContent Pattern                           → Recommended                                                             

    Block\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\nFull-width banner + heading + CTA         → Hero\nGrid of items (image + title + text)     → Cards\nSide-by-side content sections             →                     

    Columns\nExpandable Q&A pairs                      → Accordion\nRotating/sliding image gallery            → Carousel\nTabbed content switcher                   → Tabs\nEmbedded video or external content        → Embed\nData          

    table with rows/columns              → Table\n```\n\n**Example Decision Process with Reuse:**\n```\nSection 1: Full-width banner with \"Welcome!\" heading + 2 CTA buttons\n  → Search enriched catalog for \"hero\" blocks\n  →         

    Found custom variants: hero-blog (metadata: light, minimal, noimg)\n  → Current section: light background, minimal spacing, no images\n  → Calculate similarity: 95% match!\n  → ♻️  Reuse: hero-blog ✓\n\nSection 2: Grid of 4           

    items, each with image + title + description\n  → Search enriched catalog for \"cards\" blocks\n  → Found custom variants: cards-latest-articles (metadata: grid, 3-col, images)\n  → Current section: grid layout, 4 columns,           

    images\n  → Calculate similarity: 65% match (different column count)\n  → ❌ Below 70% threshold\n  → 🆕 Create new variant: cards-product ✓\n```\n\n**Output**: List of blocks to reuse + list of blocks needing new                    

    variants\n\n---\n\n#### Similarity Calculation Algorithm\n\n**Purpose**: Calculate similarity scores between current page context and existing custom block metadata.\n\nThe `calculateSimilarity(currentContext, variantContext)`       

    function uses weighted scoring:\n\n```javascript\nfunction calculateSimilarity(currentContext, variantContext) {\n  let score = 0;\n  let totalWeight = 0;\n\n  // Color scheme match (20% weight)\n  if (currentContext.colorScheme     

     === variantContext.colorScheme) {\n    score += 0.2;\n  }\n  totalWeight += 0.2;\n\n  // Density match (15% weight)\n  if (currentContext.density === variantContext.density) {\n    score += 0.15;\n  }\n  totalWeight +=              

    0.15;\n\n  // Purpose match (25% weight - most important)\n  if (currentContext.purpose === variantContext.purpose) {\n    score += 0.25;\n  }\n  totalWeight += 0.25;\n\n  // Image pattern match (20% weight)\n  if                    

    (currentContext.imagePattern === variantContext.imagePattern) {\n    score += 0.20;\n  }\n  totalWeight += 0.20;\n\n  // Content structure similarity (20% weight)\n  const structureSimilarity = compareStructures(\n                   

    currentContext.structure,\n    variantContext.structure\n  );\n  score += structureSimilarity * 0.20;\n  totalWeight += 0.20;\n\n  // Return normalized score (0-1)\n  return score / totalWeight;\n}\n\nfunction                        

    compareStructures(structure1, structure2) {\n  // Simple string similarity for structure patterns\n  // Example: \"heading + 2 CTAs\" vs \"heading + subheading + 2 CTAs\"\n\n  if (structure1 === structure2) {\n    return 1.0;        

    // Perfect match\n  }\n\n  // Extract key components\n  const components1 = structure1.toLowerCase().split(/\\s*\\+\\s*/);\n  const components2 = structure2.toLowerCase().split(/\\s*\\+\\s*/);\n\n  // Calculate overlap\n  const      

    commonComponents = components1.filter(c => components2.includes(c));\n  const totalComponents = new Set([...components1, ...components2]).size;\n\n  return commonComponents.length / totalComponents;\n}\n```\n\n**Weighting            

    Rationale**:\n- **Purpose (25%)**: Most important - determines semantic intent\n- **Color Scheme (20%)**: High impact on visual consistency\n- **Image Pattern (20%)**: Critical for layout structure\n- **Content Structure             

    (20%)**: Determines content organization\n- **Density (15%)**: Important but more flexible\n\n**Threshold Decision**:\n- **≥ 0.7 (70%)**: High confidence match - reuse variant\n- **< 0.7 (70%)**: Low confidence - create new          

    variant\n\n**Example Calculations**:\n\n```javascript\n// Example 1: High similarity (95%)\ncurrentContext = {\n  colorScheme: \"light\",\n  density: \"minimal\",\n  purpose: \"blog-hero\",\n  imagePattern: \"noimg\",\n              

    structure: \"heading + 2 CTAs\"\n};\n\nexistingVariant = {\n  colorScheme: \"light\",     // ✅ Match (0.2)\n  density: \"minimal\",       // ✅ Match (0.15)\n  purpose: \"blog-hero\",     // ✅ Match (0.25)\n  imagePattern:         

    \"noimg\",    // ✅ Match (0.20)\n  structure: \"heading + 2 CTAs\"  // ✅ Perfect match (0.20)\n};\n\n// Score: 1.0 (100%) → ♻️  REUSE\n\n// Example 2: Medium similarity (65%)\ncurrentContext = {\n  colorScheme: \"dark\",\n          

    density: \"minimal\",\n  purpose: \"product-hero\",\n  imagePattern: \"large\",\n  structure: \"heading + image + CTA\"\n};\n\nexistingVariant = {\n  colorScheme: \"light\",      // ❌ No match (0)\n  density: \"minimal\",           

      // ✅ Match (0.15)\n  purpose: \"blog-hero\",      // ❌ No match (0)\n  imagePattern: \"noimg\",     // ❌ No match (0)\n  structure: \"heading + 2 CTAs\"  // ⚠️ Partial match (0.10)\n};\n\n// Score: 0.25 / 1.0 = 0.25 (25%) →      

     🆕 CREATE NEW\n```\n\n---\n\n### Phase 3: Variant Creation and Management\n\n**Purpose**: Create new block variants or update existing ones based on Phase 2 decisions.\n\nFor each block type identified, complete these               

    actions:\n\n#### Action 0: Verify Reuse Decisions and Validate Existing Variants\n\n**Purpose**: Confirm which blocks from Phase 2 are being reused vs needing new variants, and validate reused variants have required files.\n\n1.     

     **Review Phase 2 output:**\n   ```javascript\n   // From Phase 2, you should have:\n   const reuseMapping = {\n     \"hero\": \"hero-blog\",  // Reusing existing\n     \"cards\": null,        // Create new\n     \"columns\":        

    \"columns-ad-banner\"  // Reusing existing\n   };\n\n   const blocksToCreate = Object.keys(reuseMapping).filter(k => reuseMapping[k] === null);\n   const blocksToReuse = Object.keys(reuseMapping).filter(k => reuseMapping[k] !==      

    null);\n   ```\n\n2. **Validate reused variants:**\n   ```bash\n   # For each reused variant, verify files exist\n   for variant in hero-blog columns-ad-banner; do\n     echo \"Checking $variant\"\n     if [[ -f                      

    \"blocks/$variant/$variant.js\" && -f \"blocks/$variant/$variant.css\" ]]; then\n       echo \"  ✅ $variant validated\"\n     else\n       echo \"  ❌ $variant incomplete - will create new instead\"\n       # Move from reuse to     

     create\n     fi\n   done\n   ```\n\n3. **Update usage metadata for reused blocks:**\n   ```javascript\n   // For each reused variant, update metadata.json\n   for (const [baseBlock, variantName] of Object.entries(reuseMapping))     

     {\n     if (variantName) {  // If reusing\n       const metadataPath = `blocks/${variantName}/metadata.json`;\n\n       if (fs.existsSync(metadataPath)) {\n         const metadata = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(metadataPath,          

    'utf-8'));\n\n         // Update usage tracking\n         metadata.usage.pagesUsing.push(documentPath);  // From input\n         metadata.usage.reuseCount += 1;\n         metadata.usage.lastUsed = new Date().toISOString();\n\n       

           fs.writeFileSync(metadataPath, JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2));\n         console.log(`♻️  Updated usage for ${variantName}`);\n       }\n     }\n   }\n   ```\n\n4. **Build final variant mapping:**\n   ```javascript\n       

      const variantMapping = {};\n\n   // Copy reused variants\n   for (const [baseBlock, variantName] of Object.entries(reuseMapping)) {\n     if (variantName && isValidated(variantName)) {\n       variantMapping[baseBlock] =           

    variantName;\n     }\n   }\n\n   // blocksToCreate will proceed through Actions 1-6\n   console.log(`♻️  Reusing ${Object.keys(variantMapping).length} variants`);\n   console.log(`🆕 Creating ${blocksToCreate.length} new              

    variants`);\n   ```\n\n**Output**:\n- `variantMapping` with reused blocks\n- `blocksToCreate` list for Actions 1-6\n- Updated usage metadata for reused variants\n\n**If NO blocks need creation** (all reused):\n- Skip Actions 1-6     

     entirely\n- Jump directly to output with complete variantMapping\n\n**If SOME blocks need creation**:\n- Proceed to Actions 1-6 for blocksToCreate only\n- **IMPORTANT:** Actions 1-6 must be completed for EACH block in               

    blocksToCreate list (loop through all blocks)\n\n---\n\n#### Action 1: Analyze Visual Characteristics (For New Variants Only)\n\nFrom the screenshot and page structure analysis, identify:\n- **Color scheme**: light, dark,            

    accent, grey, colored\n- **Layout density**: compact, wide, spacious, tight, minimal\n- **Purpose/context**: product, team, hero, feature, testimonial, faq\n- **Image treatment**: noimg, large,                                        

    icon\n\n**Example**:\n```javascript\n// Hero block on light background with minimal spacing\nvisualContext = {\n  colorScheme: \"light\",\n  density: \"minimal\",\n  purpose: \"blog-hero\",\n  imagePattern:                           

    \"noimg\"\n}\n```\n\n#### Action 2: Generate Variance Name\n\nCombine blockName + visual characteristic:\n- Pattern: `{blockname}-{variance}`\n- Examples: `hero-minimal`, `cards-feature`, `accordion-faq`\n- Max 15 characters for     

     variance name\n\n**Example**:\n```javascript\nblockName = \"hero\"\nvariance = \"minimal\"  // from visual analysis\nvariantName = \"hero-minimal\"\n```\n\n#### Action 3: Fetch Vanilla Block Code with CSS Class                      

    Replacement\n\nReference the project's .ec-project.json file to get the libraryUrl url.\n\n```json\n{\n  \"libraryUrl\": \"...\",\n}\n```\n\nUse the `get_vanilla_block_code` MCP tool to fetch vanilla block files with automatic       

    CSS class name replacement:\n\n**Tool**: `get_vanilla_block_code`\n\n**Parameters**:\n```javascript\n{\n  blockName: \"hero\",                  // Base block name\n  targetVariantName: \"hero-minimal\",  // Variant name from         

    Action 2 - triggers CSS replacement\n  libraryUrl,                         // Project specific library url\n  tryLocal: true                      // Try local first, fallback to remote                                                 

    library\n}\n```\n\n**Example**:\n```javascript\n// Generate variant name from Action 2\nconst blockName = \"hero\";\nconst variantName = \"hero-minimal\";\nconst libraryUrl = // the ec-project.json libraryUrl\n\n// Fetch vanilla     

     hero block code WITH CSS class replacement\nconst blockCode = await get_vanilla_block_code({\n  blockName: blockName,\n  targetVariantName: variantName,  // 🔄 Automatically replaces CSS class names\n  libraryUrl: blocks,           

            // 🔄 Automatically replace with blocks value                      \n  tryLocal: true,\n  options: {\n    ueJson: false                  // Non xwalk based projects json is optional\n  }\n});\n\n// Check for success\nif      

    (!blockCode.success) {\n  console.error(`Failed to fetch block: ${blockCode.error}`);\n  // Handle error (see Error Handling section below)\n}\n\n// Verify CSS replacement happened\nif (blockCode.cssReplaced !== true) {\n            

    console.warn(`⚠️ CSS replacement did not occur for ${variantName}`);\n}\n\n// Result contains:\n// - jsContent: \"export default function decorate(block) { ... }\" (unchanged, needs manual update)\n// - cssContent:                    

    \".hero-minimal { ... }\" (CSS classes replaced! ✅)\n// - cssReplaced: true (confirms CSS replacement happened)\n// - source: \"local\" or \"remote\"\n// - success: true\n```\n\n**Example For XWalk Based Projects**\n\nThe           

    option.jsonMandatory must be set to true, to download the modeling file.\n\n**Tool**: `get_vanilla_block_code`\n\n**Parameters**:\n```javascript\n{\n  blockName: \"hero\",                  // Base block name\n                        

    targetVariantName: \"hero-minimal\",  // Variant name from Action 2 - triggers CSS replacement\n  libraryUrl,                         // Project specific library url\n  tryLocal: true                      // Try local first,         

    fallback to remote library\n  options: {\n    ueJson: true                      // Set ueJson to true if project type is xwalk\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Store the result** for use in Actions 4-5.\n\n**CSS Replacement Examples**:\nWhen       

    `targetVariantName: \"hero-minimal\"` is provided, ALL CSS selectors starting with the base class name are replaced:\n\n**Base class replacements:**\n- `.hero` → `.hero-minimal` (space delimiter)\n- `.hero:hover` →                   

    `.hero-minimal:hover` (pseudo-class)\n- `.hero.active` → `.hero-minimal.active` (chained class)\n- `.hero[data-variant]` → `.hero-minimal[data-variant]` (attribute selector)\n\n**Compound class replacements (includes                 

    hyphen):**\n- `.hero-wrapper` → `.hero-minimal-wrapper`\n- `.hero-container` → `.hero-minimal-container`\n- `.hero-title` → `.hero-minimal-title`\n\n**NOT replaced (doesn't start with base class):**\n- `.superhero` →                 

    `.superhero` (unchanged - not a match)\n- Comments preserve original class names (unchanged)\n\n#### Action 4: Create Variant Directory\n\n```bash\n# Create directory for variant\nmkdir -p blocks/hero-minimal/\n```\n\n####           

    Action 5: Write and Update Variant Files ⛔ MANDATORY\n\nUsing the `jsContent` and `cssContent` from Action 3, complete these steps for EVERY variant:\n\n**Tool**: `Write` (Claude Code built-in tool)\n\n**1. Write JavaScript         

    file**:\n```javascript\nWrite({\n  file_path: \"blocks/hero-minimal/hero-minimal.js\",\n  content: blockCode.jsContent\n});\n```\n\n**2. Write CSS file**:\n```javascript\nWrite({\n  file_path:                                         

    \"blocks/hero-minimal/hero-minimal.css\",\n  content: blockCode.cssContent\n});\n```\n\n**3. Write metadata.json file** ⛔ MANDATORY:\n```javascript\nconst metadata = {\n  variantName: \"hero-minimal\",  // From Action 2\n           

    baseBlock: \"hero\",           // Base block type\n  version: \"1.0.0\",\n  created: new Date().toISOString(),\n\n  sourceContext: {\n    originUrl: sourcePageUrl,  // From input\n    originPage: \"blog post landing page\",\n        

     blockPosition: \"top\"  // top, middle, bottom\n  },\n\n  visualCharacteristics: {\n    colorScheme: \"light\",  // From Action 1\n    density: \"minimal\",    // From Action 1\n    purpose: \"blog-hero\",  // From Action 1\n       

      imagePattern: \"noimg\"  // From Action 1\n  },\n\n  contentPattern: {\n    structure: \"heading + subheading + 2 CTAs\",\n    buttonCount: 2,\n    imageCount: 0\n  },\n\n  reuseGuidance: {\n    suitableFor: [\n      \"blog        

    post pages\",\n      \"article landing pages\",\n      \"text-heavy content pages\"\n    ],\n    notSuitableFor: [\n      \"product pages with images\",\n      \"landing pages with background images\"\n    ]\n  },\n\n  usage:        

    {\n    pagesUsing: [currentPagePath],  // From input\n    reuseCount: 1,\n    lastUsed: new Date().toISOString()\n  }\n};\n\nWrite({\n  file_path: `blocks/${variantName}/metadata.json`,\n  content: JSON.stringify(metadata, null,     

     2)\n});\n\nconsole.log(`✅ Created variant ${variantName} with .js, .css, and metadata.json`);\n```\n\n**Why metadata.json is MANDATORY:**\n- Enables smart variant reuse in future migrations\n- Phase 1 auto-loads metadata into      

    enriched catalog\n- Phase 2 uses metadata for similarity scoring\n- Without metadata, variants become orphaned and won't be reused\n\n**Note**: Use Write tool (not bash `cp`) because:\n- MCP tool returns content as strings, not      

    file paths\n- Write tool provides proper error handling\n- Consistent with markdown file operations\n\n**4. Update JavaScript class names** ⛔ MANDATORY:\n\nAfter writing each variant's JS file, update ALL class name references      

    from `{baseBlock}` to `{variantName}`:\n\n```javascript\n// Read the JS file you just wrote\nRead({ file_path: `blocks/${variantName}/${variantName}.js` });\n\n// Replace all occurrences of base block class name with variant         

    name:\n// - '.hero-title' → '.hero-minimal-title'\n// - classList.add('hero') → classList.add('hero-minimal')\n// - className = 'cards-card-image' → className = 'cards-blog-card-image'\n// - `columns-${var}-suffix` →                 

    `columns-variant-${var}-suffix`\n\n// Use Edit tool (one or multiple edits as needed)\n```\n\n**What to replace:**\n- Class selectors in strings: `'.hero-title'`, `\".cards-card-image\"`\n- classList operations:                      

    `classList.add('hero')`\n- className assignments: `className = 'cards-card-body'`\n- Template literals: `` `columns-${variable}-cols` ``\n\n**This step must be completed for EACH block being created in the blocksToCreate             

    loop.**\n\n#### Action 6: Track Variant Mapping\n\nMaintain a mapping object for output:\n\n```javascript\nvariantMapping = {\n  \"hero\": \"hero-minimal\",\n  \"cards\": \"cards-feature\",\n  \"accordion\": \"accordion-faq\",\n     

      // ... for each block type\n}\n```\n\n#### Action 7: Update Authoring Analysis File ⛔ MANDATORY\n\n**CRITICAL:** You MUST update the existing `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json` file with variant names. DO NOT create a     

     new file.\n\n**Steps:**\n\n1. **Read the existing authoring-analysis.json file:**\n   ```javascript\n   Read({ file_path: \"./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json\" });\n   ```\n\n2. **Apply variant mapping to update block        

    names:**\n   ```javascript\n   // For each section in authoring analysis\n   for (const section of authoringAnalysis.sections) {\n     for (const sequence of section.sequences) {\n       if (sequence.blockName &&                     

    variantMapping[sequence.blockName]) {\n         // Replace generic block name with variant name\n         sequence.blockName = variantMapping[sequence.blockName];\n         sequence.blockVariant =                                     

    variantMapping[sequence.blockName];\n       }\n     }\n   }\n   ```\n\n3. **Write the updated analysis back to the SAME file:**\n   ```javascript\n   Write({\n     file_path: \"./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json\",\n           

    content: JSON.stringify(authoringAnalysis, null, 2)\n   });\n   ```\n\n**Important:**\n- ✅ UPDATE existing `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json` file\n- ❌ DO NOT create `authoring-analysis-enhanced.json` or any other new      

    file\n- ✅ Replace generic block names (e.g., \"hero\") with variant names (e.g., \"hero-minimal\")\n- ✅ Preserve all other data from the original analysis\n\n**Optional: Generate human-readable                                      

    README.md:**\n```javascript\nconst readme = `# ${variantName}\n\nCustom variant of the ${baseBlock} block created from ${sourcePageUrl}.\n\n## When to Reuse\n✅ Suitable for: ${metadata.reuseGuidance.suitableFor.join(', ')}\n❌      

    Not suitable for: ${metadata.reuseGuidance.notSuitableFor.join(', ')}\n\n## Usage: ${metadata.usage.pagesUsing.length} pages\n`;\n\nWrite({\n  file_path: `blocks/${variantName}/README.md`,\n  content:                                 

    readme\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## Error Handling\n\n**If `get_vanilla_block_code` fails for a block:**\n\n1. **Check the error message**:\n   - `\"Block not found in local project or remote library\"` → Block doesn't exist               

    anywhere\n   - `\"Fetch timeout\"` → Network issue, retry or check connectivity\n   - `\"Invalid block name\"` → Block name contains invalid characters\n\n2. **Recovery strategies**:\n   - **Use alternative block**: If \"hero\"      

    fails, try similar block like \"section\" or \"banner\"\n   - **Create minimal variant anyway**: Even if fetch fails, create variant with placeholder code\n   - **Document the issue**: Add note for manual follow-up\n\n3.             

    **Example error handling**:\n   ```javascript\n   const blockCode = await get_vanilla_block_code({ blockName: 'hero', tryLocal: true });\n\n   if (!blockCode.success) {\n     console.error(`⚠️ Failed to fetch hero block:              

    ${blockCode.error}`);\n     console.warn(`⚠️ Creating variant with minimal placeholder code`);\n     // Still create variant (never use vanilla directly)\n     // Create minimal JS/CSS files and mark for manual follow-up\n   }        

    else {\n     // Normal variant creation (Actions 4-5)\n     variantMapping['hero'] = 'hero-minimal';\n   }\n   ```\n\n---\n\n## Validation\n\n**Before completing, verify:**\n\n```bash\n# Check variant directories exist\nls -la       

    blocks/*-*/\n\n# Expected output shows directories like:\n# drwxr-xr-x  blocks/hero-minimal/\n# drwxr-xr-x  blocks/cards-feature/\n# drwxr-xr-x  blocks/accordion-faq/\n\n# Verify each variant has .js, .css, AND metadata.json         

    files\nfor dir in blocks/*-*/; do\n  blockname=$(basename \"$dir\")\n  echo \"Checking $dir\"\n  if [[ -f \"${dir}${blockname}.js\" && -f \"${dir}${blockname}.css\" && -f \"${dir}metadata.json\" ]]; then\n    echo \"  ✅             

    ${blockname}.js, ${blockname}.css, and metadata.json found\"\n  else\n    echo \"  ❌ Missing files in $dir\"\n    ls -la \"$dir\"\n    [[ ! -f \"${dir}${blockname}.js\" ]] && echo \"    Missing: ${blockname}.js\"\n    [[ ! -f       

    \"${dir}${blockname}.css\" ]] && echo \"    Missing: ${blockname}.css\"\n    [[ ! -f \"${dir}metadata.json\" ]] && echo \"    Missing: metadata.json ⛔\"\n  fi\ndone\n```\n\n**Verify JavaScript class names were                       

    updated:**\n```bash\n# For each variant, check that JS uses variant class names (not base block names)\nfor dir in blocks/*-*/; do\n  blockname=$(basename \"$dir\")\n  baseblock=$(echo \"$blockname\" | cut -d'-' -f1)\n\n  echo       

    \"Checking JS class names in $blockname\"\n\n  # Check if base block class names still exist in JS (they shouldn't)\n  if grep -q \"'${baseblock}-\" \"${dir}${blockname}.js\" 2>/dev/null; then\n    echo \"  ⚠️  Found base block       

    class names in JS - Action 5 step 4 not completed!\"\n    echo \"  → Must replace '${baseblock}-' with '${blockname}-' in JavaScript\"\n  else\n    echo \"  ✅ JavaScript class names updated correctly\"\n  fi\ndone\n```\n\n**If      

    ANY variant has base block class names in JS:**\n1. Read the JS file\n2. Find all class name references to base block\n3. Use Edit tool to replace with variant name\n4. Repeat verification\n\n**Do NOT return until all variants       

    are validated with correct class names.**\n\n---\n\n## Success Criteria\n\nThis skill is complete when:\n- ✅ Enriched catalog loaded (custom + vanilla blocks)\n- ✅ Similarity scoring completed for all sections\n- ✅ Reuse          

    decisions made (≥70% threshold)\n- ✅ Existing variants' metadata.json updated with new usage\n- ✅ New variant directories created (if needed)\n- ✅ All new variants have .js, .css, and metadata.json files\n- ✅ JavaScript          

    files updated with variant class names (Action 5 step 4)\n- ✅ Variant mapping object generated\n- ✅ Existing `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json` file updated with variant names (Action 7)\n\n**Output**: \n- Updated          

    `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json` file with variant block names\n- `variantMapping` object for reference\n\nExample:\n```javascript\n{\n  \"hero\": \"hero-minimal\",\n  \"cards\": \"cards-product\",\n  \"columns\":          

    \"columns-simple\"  // All variants, never vanilla\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Integration with Orchestrator\n\nThis skill is invoked by excat-page-migration orchestrator skill:\n\n**Input from orchestrator:**\n- Authoring analysis         

    (with generic block names)\n- Screenshot path\n- Source URL\n- Current page path\n\n**Output to orchestrator:**\n- Updated `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json` file (with variant block names replacing generic names)\n-         

    Variant mapping object for reference\n\nThe orchestrator passes the enhanced authoring analysis to generate-migration-markdown skill.\n\n**CRITICAL:** The authoring-analysis.json file is updated in-place. No new files are

      "instructions": "---\nname: interactive-block-review\ndescription: Enables the user to visually review or adjust block mappings before markdown generation. Opens a browser with an overlay UI to highlight blocks and let users       

    remap variants interactively.\n---\n\n## What it does\n- Opens the provided source page URL in a Playwright MCP controlled browser.\n- Injects `scripts/highlight-blocks.js` to outline detected blocks and render a floating list +     

     dropdown UI.\n- Persists user changes to `window.__EXCAT_BLOCK_REVIEW__` so the workflow can read them.\n- Polls for changes and updates related project artifacts\n\n## Inputs\n- `url`: the page the user asked to migrate            

    (workflow `sourcePage`).\n- `./migration-work/page-structure.json` → read for block inventory and section data.\n- `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json` → read for `variantMapping` and `enhancedAuthoring`.\n-                    

    `availableVariants` to populate dropdowns.\n- Script path: `excat/skills/interactive-block-review/scripts/highlight-blocks.js`.\n\n## Run flow\n1. **Read source files:**\n   - Load `./migration-work/page-structure.json` →            

    extract `blocks` array for overlays.\n   - Load `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json` → extract `variantMapping` and `enhancedAuthoring`.\n2. Launch Playwright MCP browser and navigate to `url`.\n3. Seed the page with           

    `window.__EXCAT_BLOCK_REVIEW__ = { blocks, availableVariants, variantMapping, enhancedAuthoring }`.\n4. Inject and execute the highlight script (e.g., `page.addScriptTag({ path })`).\n5. Let the user adjust mappings in the           

    floating UI and click **Save**.\n6. Read `window.__EXCAT_BLOCK_REVIEW__`:\n   - `updatedMapping` → `reviewedVariantMapping` (fallback to `variantMapping`).\n   - `updatedEnhancedAuthoring` → `reviewedEnhancedAuthoring` (fallback     

     to `enhancedAuthoring`).\n   - `summary` → `blockReviewSummary` (changes + timestamp).\n\n## Poll for changes\nEvery 5 seconds, check `window.__EXCAT_BLOCK_REVIEW__`:\n- If `shouldCloseBrowser === true` → close the browser          

    immediately.\n- If `updatedMapping` is present → user clicked **Save**; read results and close.\n\n## Persist changes\nAfter **Save**, update the migration-work files with reviewed data:\n-

      "instructions": "---\nname: generate-migration-markdown\ndescription: Generate Edge Delivery Services-compliant markdown from authoring analysis. Creates block tables with variant names, applies section metadata, handles page      

    metadata, and manages images folder. Used by enhanced migration workflows.\n---\n\n# Generate Migration Markdown\n\nCreate AEM markdown file with block table structure from authoring analysis.\n\n## When to Use This Skill\n\nUse     

     this skill when:\n- You have complete authoring analysis with block selections\n- Block variant names are determined (from block-variant-manager)\n- Ready to generate markdown for HTML conversion\n\n**Invoked by:**                  

    excat-page-migration skill (Step 5)\n\n## Prerequisites\n\nFrom previous skills, you need:\n- ✅ Authoring analysis file at `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json` (updated by block-variant-manager with variant block              

    names)\n- ✅ Section styling decisions (from authoring-analysis)\n- ✅ metadata.json with paths, metadata, image mapping (from scrape-webpage, with content/ prefix)\n- ✅ cleaned.html with content (from scrape-webpage)\n- ✅         

    Block examples fetched (from authoring-analysis)\n\n## Related Skills\n\n- **excat-page-migration** - Orchestrator that invokes this skill\n- **authoring-analysis** - Provides authoring decisions\n- **block-variant-manager** -       

    Provides variant block names\n- **scrape-webpage** - Provides metadata and paths\n\n## ⚠️ CRITICAL: Complete Content Migration\n\n**YOU MUST MIGRATE ALL CONTENT. PARTIAL MIGRATION IS UNACCEPTABLE.**\n\n- ❌ NEVER truncate or          

    skip sections\n- ❌ NEVER summarize or abbreviate content\n- ❌ NEVER use placeholders like \"<!-- rest of content -->\"\n- ✅ ALWAYS migrate every section from authoring analysis\n- ✅ ALWAYS include all text, images, and           

    structure\n\n---\n\n## Markdown Generation Workflow\n\n### Step 1: Generate Block Tables with Variant Names\n\nFor each section in authoring analysis, generate AEM markdown:\n\n**For blocks:** Use block table format with variant     

     names\n\n```markdown\n+---------------------------------------+\n| **Hero-Minimal**                      |\n+---------------------------------------+\n| # **Page Heading**                    |\n|                                     

           |\n| Description text here                 |\n|                                       |\n| **[Call to Action](/path)**           |\n+---------------------------------------+\n```\n\n**For default content:** Use standard       

    markdown (headings, paragraphs, lists)\n\n```markdown\n## Section Heading\n\nParagraph text content.\n\n- List item 1\n- List item 2\n```\n\n**Key rules:**\n- Use **variant names** from block-variant-manager (e.g.,                   

    \"Cards-Product\", not \"Cards\")\n- Follow exact block structure from examples (row/column count)\n- Align column markers (`+`) exactly across all rows\n- Place images on separate lines within cells\n- Separate sections with        

    `---` horizontal rules\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Add Section Metadata Tables\n\nFor sections requiring styling (validated in authoring-analysis Step 3e):\n\n```markdown\n+--------------------+---------+\n| **Section Metadata**           

       |\n+--------------------+---------+\n| Style              | dark    |\n+--------------------+---------+\n\n<!-- Section content follows -->\n```\n\n**Only add if:** Validated in authoring-analysis that section needs container     

     styling.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Add Page Metadata Table\n\nUnless user explicitly skipped, add metadata block at end:\n\n```markdown\n---\n\n+---------------------+--------------------------------+\n| **Metadata**                    

                            |\n+---------------------+--------------------------------+\n| Title               | Page Title                     |\n+---------------------+--------------------------------+\n| Description         |         

    Page description               |\n+---------------------+--------------------------------+\n| Image               | https://example.com/image.jpg  |\n+---------------------+--------------------------------+\n```\n\n**Rules:**\n-     

     Extract from metadata.json\n- Only include properties that differ from AEM defaults\n- Use absolute URLs for images\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Add Source Comment\n\nPrepend source URL at top of markdown:\n\n```markdown\n<!-- source:     

     https://example.com/page -->\n\n[rest of markdown content]\n```\n\n---\n\n### Step 5: Copy Images Folder\n\nCopy images to same directory as markdown file:\n\n```bash\n# Use paths.dirPath from metadata.json to get the markdown      

    directory\n# Example: if mdFilePath is \"content/blog/page.md\", dirPath is \"content/blog\"\nmkdir -p ${paths.dirPath}/images\ncp -r ./migration-work/images/* ${paths.dirPath}/images/\n```\n\n**Rule:** Images folder MUST be in      

    the same directory as the markdown file.\n- If markdown is at `content/blog/page.md` → images go to `content/blog/images/`\n- If markdown is at `content/index.md` → images go to `content/images/`\n\n**Image references in             

    markdown:** Use relative paths `./images/filename.png`\n\n---\n\n### Step 6: Save Markdown File\n\n**Save to:** `paths.mdFilePath` from metadata.json (e.g., `content/index.md`)\n\n```javascript\nWrite({\n  file_path:                 

    metadata.paths.mdFilePath,  // e.g., \"content/index.md\"\n  content: completeMarkdown\n});\n```\n\n**After save:** Hook automatically converts to .plain.html and .html\n\n---\n\n## Validation Checklist\n\nBefore completing,         

    verify:\n- ✅ Section count: Markdown has all sections from identify-page-structure\n- ✅ All sequences: Every content sequence from authoring-analysis included\n- ✅ No truncation: No placeholders or summaries\n- ✅ Variant         

    names: Block headers use variant names (e.g., **Hero-Minimal**)\n- ✅ Table alignment: Column markers (`+`) align exactly\n- ✅ Markdown saved: File written to content/ directory\n- ✅ Images copied: Images folder exists in          

    content/images/\n\n**If any check fails, STOP and fix before proceeding.**\n\n---\n\n## Output\n\nThis skill provides:\n- ✅ Markdown file at correct path (e.g., `content/index.md`)\n- ✅ Images folder in content/images/\n- ✅       

    Complete content migration\n- ✅ Proper AEM block table structure with variant names\n- ✅ Section metadata tables applied\n- ✅ Page metadata table included\n\n**Hook automatically generates:**\n- content/index.plain.html           

    (semantic HTML)\n- content/index.html (full HTML with head/body)\n\n---\n\n## Common Block Table Patterns\n\n**Hero block:**\n```markdown\n+------------------------------------+\n| **Hero-Minimal**                                    

    |\n+------------------------------------+\n| # **Heading**                      |\n|                                    |\n| Description text                   |\n|                                    |\n| **[Button](/path)**         

                |\n+------------------------------------+\n```\n\n**Cards block (2-column table, one row per card):**\n```markdown\n+------------------------------+------------------------------+\n| **Cards-Product**                     

                             |\n+------------------------------+------------------------------+\n| ![Image](url)                | **Card Title**               |\n|                              | Card description                          

    |\n+------------------------------+------------------------------+\n| ![Image 2](url2)             | **Card 2 Title**             |\n|                              | Card 2 description                                                 

    |\n+------------------------------+------------------------------+\n```\n\n**Columns block:**\n```markdown\n+------------------------------+------------------------------+\n| **Columns**                                               

         |\n+------------------------------+------------------------------+\n| ## Left Column               | ## Right Column              |\n|                              |                              |\n| Content here                

          | Content here                 |\n+------------------------------+------------------------------+\n```\n\n---\n\n## Integration with excat-page-migration\n\nThis skill is invoked by excat-page-migration at Step                 

    5:\n\n**Input:**\n- Authoring analysis file at `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json` (updated by block-variant-manager in Step 4 with variant block names)\n- Section styling decisions\n- metadata.json with content/ prefixed     

     paths\n- cleaned.html\n\n**IMPORTANT:** Read the authoring analysis from `./migration-work/authoring-analysis.json`. This file was updated in Step 4 with variant names (e.g., \"hero-minimal\") replacing generic names (e.g.,         

    \"hero\"). Do NOT look for a separate \"enhanced\" or \"authoring-analysis-enhanced.json\" file.\n\n**Output:**\n- Markdown file saved to content/[page-name].md\n- Images copied to content/images/\n- Hook auto-converts to HTML       

    files\n\n**Next step:** preview-import uses the .html files\n",

      "instructions": "---\nname: excat-import-infrastructure\ndescription: Creates import infrastructure (page templates, block parsers, page transformers) during single page migrations for use with future multi-page (bulk) import      

    operations.\n---\n\n# Import Infrastructure Orchestrator\n\n## Complete Workflow Checklist\n\n**⛔ All steps are REQUIRED - follow in order:**\n\n- [ ] **STEP 1: Generate or Update Page Template**\n- [ ] **STEP 2: Generate           

    Import Transformers**\n- [ ] **STEP 3: Generate Block Parsers**\n- [ ] **STEP 4: Final Verification**\n\n**⛔ DO NOT proceed to next step until current step is complete.**\n\n## Overview\n\nThis skill generates complete import       

    infrastructure for AEM content migration. This infrastructure enables automated content import workflows across multiple pages.\n\n**Prerequisites:**\n- Block variants identified/created during page migration\n- Section              

    identification completed\n- Block variant mapping available \n- Source HTML and DOM selectors available for each block\n- Markdown file generated with variant names\n\n- ✅ DO: Generate page-templates.json with all sections and      

    block mappings\n- ✅ DO: Generate transformers for site-wide DOM cleanup\n- ✅ DO: Generate parser functions for all block variants\n- ✅ DO: Validate parsers using parser-validator tool\n- ✅ DO: Iterate until validation            

    passes\n- ❌ DON'T: Generate analysis reports\n- ❌ DON'T: Create documentation files unless explicitly requested\n- ❌ DON'T: Skip validation - parsers must be tested before completion\n- ❌ DON'T: Skip transformer                  

    generation\n- ❌ DON'T: Create transformers for block-specific tasks (use parsers)\n\n**Key Differences: Transformers vs. Parsers**\n\n| Aspect | Transformers | Parsers |\n|--------|-------------|---------|\n| **Scope** | Entire     

     DOM | Single block element |\n| **Purpose** | Cleanup, removal, fixing | Convert HTML to AEM table format |\n| **Timing** | Before/after parsing | During block processing |\n| **Output** | Modified DOM (in-place) | Table cell       

    array |\n| **Location** | `tools/importer/transformers/` | `tools/importer/parsers/` |\n\n## Complete Workflow\n\n### STEP 1: Generate Page Templates\n\n**Create tools/importer directory**\n\n```bash\nmkdir -p                        

    tools/importer\n```\n\n**⚠️ CRITICAL: Follow the complete page template generation guide:** `./references/generate-page-template.md`\n\n### STEP 2: Generate Import Transformers\n\nCreate transformer functions for site-wide DOM        

    cleanup.\n\n**⚠️ CRITICAL: Follow the complete transformer generation guide:** `./references/generate-import-transformer.md`\n\n### STEP 3: Generate Block Parsers\n\n```bash\nmkdir -p tools/importer/parsers\n```\n\n**⚠️                

    CRITICAL: Follow the complete parser generation guide:** `./references/generate-import-parser.md`\n\n**CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS**:\n- ✅ **MANDATORY for EVERY migration** - No exceptions\n- ✅ **MUST generate parsers for ALL            

    variants** (both newly created and reused)\n- ❌ **Migration is INCOMPLETE without parsers** - do not skip this action\n\n### STEP 4: Final Verification\n\n**4.1 Verify all files generated:**\n\n```bash\n# Required files\ncat        

    tools/importer/page-templates.json\nls -la tools/importer/parsers/\nls -la tools/importer/transformers/\n```\n\n**4.2 Completion checklist:**\n\n- [ ] `tools/importer/page-templates.json` exists\n- [ ]                                

    `tools/importer/parsers/${variant}.js` file exists for EVERY block variant\n- [ ] All parsers validated and passing\n- [ ] All transformers validated and passing\n\n**4.3 Verify no import.js was created:**\n\n```bash\n# Check        

    for import.js (should NOT exist)\nls tools/importer/import.js 2>/dev/null && echo \"❌ ERROR: import.js should not exist\" || echo \"✅ No import.js found\"\n```\n\n**⚠️ CRITICAL**: An `import.js` file should **NOT** be               

    generated in `tools/importer/`. The import infrastructure consists of:\n- ✅ `page-templates.json` (template definitions)\n- ✅ `parsers/*.js` (individual parser files for each block variant)\n- ✅ `transformers/*.js`                

    (transformer files for DOM cleanup)\n- ❌ `import.js` (should NOT exist - this is generated by a separate skill)\n\nIf `import.js` exists, it was created by mistake and should be removed:\n\n```bash\nrm                               

    tools/importer/import.js\n```\n\n## Reference Documentation\n\n- **`./references/generate-page-template.md`** - Page template specification and structure\n- **`./references/generate-import-transformer.md`** - Complete                

    transformer generation guide\n- **`./references/generate-import-parser.md`** - Complete parser generation guide with validation\n- **Parser validation Tool**: `../scripts/parser-validator.js` ",

   User requested migration of https://www.innovationbanking.cibc.com/ (CIBC Innovation Banking homepage) to AEM Edge Delivery Services. The project was identified as an xwalk (Universal Editor/Crosswalk) type, requiring proper

providing feedback to fix issues with the carousel-hero block structure, specifically:
